verdict.rationale: Phaser has hosted services, including the Game Agent MCP server and one-click publishing, so a sandbox or test environment is a fair question for it. However, the evidence pack documents no sandbox, staging, or test-mode environment kept separate from production data. Running multiple Scenes or using the MCP tools is not sandbox isolation, so neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
